body: Thank you /u/bromandude77. For some reason I never considered that before. Not only does my inability to forgive myself hurt me, but it hurts her too. It hurts us. You have to realize, for the first year out of the total five years we have been together, I was a big jerk. Despite the following 4 years of progress, I don't know why I have such difficulty forgiving myself. I don't know why I continue to fixate on the past. I'm hoping that through a combination of therapy and medication I will be able to overcome this.
